title: Design: long and special matrix and category names on the Matrices list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with a long name with spaces that no other record of that kind has, at least 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Plan), pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingPlanTier).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, with a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingPlanTier).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's, matrix B's and matrix C's names each stay inside the Matrix column of their own row and never cover the Status column.
  • Category A's name stays inside matrix A's Categories cell and never covers the Work Order Matrix column.
  • Every column and the row's pencil and three-dot button stay visible, and the page does not scroll sideways.
  • Matrix C's name shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.
  • The column headings keep their places, as in picture 6.2.
